name: presidocs
//trustedDependencies: Empty on purpose: ALL dependency lifecycle scripts (preinstall/install/postinstall) are blocked. Verified safe — the native-binary deps (sharp, esbuild, workerd via wrangler) ship their binaries as optionalDependencies platform packages, not via these scripts, so a clean install still works with everything blocked. A future dep that genuinely needs a script is blocked and surfaced by `bun pm untrusted` for a deliberate decision. See methodology.md → Supply-chain: install policy.
//: This is the reusable blog ENGINE, consumed by content repos via a `file:` dependency (see methodology.md → Repository layout, and templates/content-repo/ for the starter). It is not a deployable blog itself; the dev/build/deploy/generate scripts live in each content repo's package.json.

scripts.test:e2e: for f in ./e2e/*.e2e.ts; do echo "=== $f ==="; bun test "$f" || exit 1; done
